requirements.en: Digitize assigned oral-history carriers using approved settings and traceable capture notes.
requirements.zh: 使用获批设置及可追溯采集备注，将分配的口述历史载体数字化。

requirements.en: Check captured files and verify copies in managed storage using checksums.
requirements.zh: 检查采集文件，并使用校验和验证受管理存储中的副本。

requirements.en: Preserve unresolved descriptive conflicts and distinguish carriers, capture files and interviews.
requirements.zh: 保留未解决描述冲突，并区分载体、采集文件及访谈。

requirements.en: Maintain clear collection handovers within archival access-approval controls.
requirements.zh: 在档案访问审批控制范围内维护清晰馆藏交接。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently restore damaged recordings and clear public-release rights.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立修复受损录音，并办理公开发布所需的权利许可。
